admission.justification: A production database write spelled attached, qualified, quoted, aliased or WITH-prefixed would escape the static check.

applicability: The static retirement check over production SQL spellings.
conditions: The reader classifies attached, qualified, quoted, aliased and WITH-prefixed forms.
exclusions: Raw string or comment occurrences that name no write.
statement: The static retirement check detects attached expressions and row writes using qualified, quoted or aliased tables and WITH prefixes.
